h1: Tube and pipe benders — hydraulic, electric and air-hydraulic, value line
intro: Benders for the fabrication shop, the roll-cage and chassis builder, the exhaust shop and the plumber and electrician — lower in price than the CNC and NC rotary-draw benders on the other pages of this section, for the shop that bends tube and pipe every week but does not need mandrel bending or programmed 3-D parts. NovoTech's value-line benders are built in China to our specification: JTB hydraulic PLC tube benders to 3-1/8″, the TBM-60 electric top bender to 2-1/2″, the HTB-25T 25-ton tubing bender, the air- and electric-hydraulic TB-3 benders and the HTB-1000 for 2″ schedule 40 pipe, the HTB-2000 exhaust bender with swager and expander and the EHB-10 electric hydraulic pipe bender. Dies, parts and support from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

groups.title: Hydraulic and electric tube benders
groups.lead: Powered benders for tube, pipe, square tube and bar — from the PLC bender to the 25-ton tubing bender.

groups.title: Electric hydraulic pipe bender
groups.lead: A push-type bender with an electric pump for plumbing, electrical and maintenance pipe work.

faq.a: A rotary-draw bender (JTB, TBM-60, HTB-25T, TB-3, HTB-1000) pulls the tube around a die with a clamp and a follower — a tight, accurate bend with little flattening, the method for roll cages, railings, frames and exhaust. A push-type hydraulic pipe bender (EHB-10) pushes the pipe into a die between two supports — simple and fast for plumbing and electrical pipe, where some ovality is acceptable. For large radii, rings and spirals, see the tube rollers on the angle rolls page.

faq.q: What do I need to tell you to choose the dies?
faq.a: The outside diameter (or the square size), the wall thickness, the material and the centre-line radius (CLR) of the bend — usually 2 to 4 times the tube diameter. Tube and pipe sizes differ: 1-1/2″ schedule 40 pipe is 1.900″ OD, while 1-1/2″ tube is 1.500″ OD — the die must fit the OD exactly.

faq.q: When do I need a CNC or mandrel bender instead?
faq.a: When the wall is thin for its diameter (thin-wall stainless, aluminum, exhaust tube on tight radii) a mandrel inside the tube prevents wrinkling and flattening; when parts have several bends in different planes, a CNC bender positions length and rotation automatically. The ISITAN CNC and NC tube benders on the other pages of this section do both.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models whose main motor is 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less — a machine with a motor above 2.2 kW must run on three-phase power and cannot be converted to 240 V single-phase. Manual machines have no electrics.
